identity.name: Dr. Mina Harker
identity.concept: Infected pathologist hunting the thing that turned her

sfx.name: Hinder
sfx.text: Switch out this distinction's d8 for a d4 to gain a Plot Point.

sfx.name: Hinder
sfx.text: Switch out this distinction's d8 for a d4 to gain a Plot Point.

sfx.name: Predator's Calm
sfx.text: When acting against vampiric creatures, spend a Plot Point to step up Mind for one roll.

power_sets.name: Tainted Blood
power_sets.description: An incomplete vampiric turn six months ago left her with the gifts but not the full curse. She is still Mina; she will not be Mina forever.

sfx.name: Feed
sfx.text: Step up or double Inhuman Strength for one roll. Add a Hunger complication d6, or step it up if it already exists.

sfx.name: Resilient
sfx.text: Spend a Plot Point to ignore physical stress or trauma from a single non-magical attack.

limits.name: Sunlight
limits.text: Earn 1 PP when sunlight, holy ground, or running water shuts down all Tainted Blood powers until the next nightfall.

limits.name: Hunger
limits.text: Earn 1 PP when Hunger or unfed thirst forces you into a poor decision in a scene.

signature_items.name: Grandfather's Crucifix
signature_items.description: Antique silver, blessed three times. A reminder of the man she was supposed to marry.

signature_items.name: Field Autopsy Kit
signature_items.description: Modified for fast triage of the unnatural. She has dissected things that should not have organs.

tiers.1 XP: Use a Tainted Blood power in front of a colleague who didn't already know.
tiers.3 XP: Refuse to feed when feeding would solve your immediate problem.
tiers.10 XP: Either fully embrace what you are, or find someone willing and able to cure you — and act on the choice.

notes: Last fed five days ago. Knows the name 'Strigoi-Voivode' but not what it means.
